summary_1line: Sita tearfully insists on accompanying Rama to the forest, arguing that devotion and destiny bind her to him despite the hardships he describes.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita stands before Rama with tears on her cheeks, pleading softly as he tries to dissuade her from following him into the forest.
Sita imagines fierce forest beasts—lions, elephants, and birds—fleeing in terror at the sight of Rama’s radiant face.
